# 2 = must block, 0 = must allow. Run with:
#   test-hooks.sh  <hook>  cases/check-file.tsv  --event PostToolUse --tool Edit
# (--tool Edit maps the payload into tool_input.file_path — see test-hooks.sh
# header. Use --tool Write too if the hook also matches Write.)
# Paths below are PLACEHOLDERS. Substitute your own project's paths:
#   OUTSIDE   a path that is not under the project root at all
#   IN-REPO   a path inside the repo but outside the linted subtree
#   GREEN     a real file inside the linted subtree that is clean at baseline
#   VIOLATION a real file inside the linted subtree with an actual new violation
# The must-ALLOW cases for GREEN are not optional, and GREEN must be verified
# clean at baseline BEFORE it goes in this file: run the lint tool on it
# directly first. A must-allow case that targets an already-red file proves
# nothing in an already-red repo — it would "pass" even if the hook never ran.
# --- outside the project entirely: must always be allowed ---------------------
# --- inside the repo, but outside the linted subtree: must be allowed ---------
